name: Stratyfix
description:
Stratyfix is an AI-driven sales intelligence platform. This connector lets managers and reps ask about their own Stratyfix data in the chat they already use. Are we going to make the quarter? Who needs my attention this week? The answers come from the live platform.

Every person connects as themselves. A rep sees their own book and a manager sees their team, with the same permissions as the app itself. It is read only, so nothing in Stratyfix can be changed from chat. And it does not bluff. When Stratyfix withholds a number on purpose, because the odds are not calibrated yet or a target is not set, the connector says exactly that instead of guessing.

You need a Stratyfix workspace, with the connector enabled by your administrator.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stratyfix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stratyfix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.stratyfix.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stratyfix MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stratyfix provides these MCP tools: coaching_queue, deal_brief, my_deal_risk, my_deals, my_pace, team_coverage, team_gap_ledger, team_pace, team_target_odds, and triage_proposals.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stratyfix?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Stratyfix in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Stratyfix requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stratyfix is developed by Stratyfix. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
